d: A collection of grotesque, oversized humanoid figures resembling distorted chess pieces with pale grey, stony skin. They possess asymmetrical, bulging muscular forms with varying numbers of elongated limbs and jagged, obsidian-colored protrusions emerging from their torsos. Each entity has a thick, stubby tail ending in a blunt, bone-like knob and three thick claws per hand. BODY COLOR: pale grey
